objectives: Identify whether a learner adds /t/ in a taught silent-t word.
Read and spell listen, castle, whistle, and fasten accurately.
Keep t in conventional spelling without pronouncing it in the taught set.
Show improvement on fresh reassessment items before advancing.
concepts: Remediation responds to a specific observed error.
In the taught set, t remains written but is not pronounced.
Fresh items test transfer beyond memorised examples.
